Prane autostrades Tirane-Durres ne kompleksin rezidencial Univers City ofrohet apartament 2+1 per shitje.

Per me shume informacion ose shoqerim ne prone lutemi te na kontaktoni.
title_en: A 2+1 apartment is offered for sale near the Tirana-Durres highway in the Univers City residential complex.
description_en: A 2+1 apartment is offered for sale near the Tirana-Durres highway in the Univers City residential complex. The apartment is located on the 4th floor of a newly completed building with an elevator. Sip. of the apartment is 96.54 m2 and is invested with extra works. The organization of the apartment is divided into: distribution corridor, two bedrooms, living room with cooking area, a toilet and a balcony with a direct view of the park. The open view and orientation make this apartment quite interesting. For more information or assistance in the property, please contact us.
